connector.name: Umami Compass
connector.registryDescription: Secure Umami Analytics MCP server for Cloud and self-hosted deployments
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package umami-compass. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the webcredo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UMAMI_API_KEY
env.description: Umami Cloud or client API key

env.name: UMAMI_API_URL
env.description: Optional exact Umami API root for a reverse proxy

env.name: UMAMI_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
env.description: Maximum decoded upstream JSON response size in bytes
